description: INSPECT is a graphical input-preparation tool for IDARC-2D nonlinear structural analysis. Its contributors publish C# and SQLite source for defining structural models and generating the text input files used by IDARC-2D. The SoftwareX abstract reports comparison with existing IDARC-2D files, not independent validation of earthquake performance. A user supplies a building configuration, ground-motion case and analysis settings; spatial scope, structural resolution and event duration vary with that case. INSPECT can reduce data-entry mistakes when preparing earthquake simulations of buildings and other structures. The journal GitHub archive exposes the source without a fee, and the publisher code table states BSD-3-Clause. The repository has no README, so setup must be inferred from the article and project files. It depends on .NET Framework 4.5.1 and IDARC-2D. No related catalogue record was identified. No IDARC-2D input was generated and no structural analysis was run.
